phy-http-cache-audit 1.0.0 – initial release

- Analyze HTTP caching headers for any URL or local dev server using only curl (no external APIs).
- Checks Cache-Control directives, ETag/Last-Modified presence, Vary correctness, CDN cache status, and stale-while-revalidate support.
- Identifies cache issues like no-store on static assets, misconfigured max-age, risky Vary headers, and missing immutable flags for hashed files.
- Generates copy-paste cache config lines for nginx, Apache, Cloudflare, Fastly, or Next.js based on analysis.
- Can audit single URLs, all assets loaded by a site (via HAR), or local endpoints.
- Supports detailed trigger phrases for flexible workflow integration.
